name: query-without-vseed
description: {zh-CN}通过图表维度、度量和筛选直接 query()，返回以字段 ID 命名的查询结果。示例随后独立调用 buildVSeed() 渲染表格，两次操作各执行一次查询。{/zh-CN}{en-US}Execute query() from chart dimensions, measures and filters. Result keys preserve field IDs. The example then calls buildVSeed() independently to render a table; each operation executes one query.{/en-US}
